source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of August 20, 2026, there were approximately 823 million shares of the Registrant's Common Stock outstanding.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as CRM. The 10-Q cover for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (filed August 27, 2026) is the latest count and is rounded by the company to approximately 823 million; the proxy's exact count was 818,219,088 at March 25, 2026. Preferred stock is authorized but none is outstanding.
